Scan an existing Markdown vault and backfill required frontmatter fields
(title, created, tags) in place. Existing frontmatter keys and unknown fields
are preserved byte-for-byte. Pre-adoption versions are captured in the version
history safety net (.symdesk/history/) before any file is written.

Usage:
  symdesk vault adopt [<dir>] [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run   list what would change without modifying files on disk
  -h, --help      help for adopt

Global Flags:
      --json            output in JSON format
      --output string   output format: text|json|yaml (--json is shorthand for --output json)
      --vault string    override document vault path (the Markdown workspace; unrelated to symvault)
